description: This file defines the interface 'ImageToolkitInterface' for image manipulation toolkits in Drupal, including methods for setting source, validation, saving, and retrieving image properties, as well as toolkit capabilities.

classes.name: ImageToolkitInterface
classes.description: Interface for image toolkit plugins providing methods for image source management, validation, saving, and capabilities.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source path of the image file; cannot be changed after initial set.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Retrieves the source path of the image file.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the current image is valid.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the image resource to a specified destination.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Determines if a file contains a valid image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: getRequirements
methods.description: Provides toolkit requirements for system checks.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the toolkit is available on the system.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs a specified operation on the image with given arguments.
